purpose: End-to-end OCR smoke evaluation for the Commerce Demo scanned-PDF fixture; not a representative accuracy benchmark.

limitations: Both pages are synthetic, clean, digitally composed raster pages, not authentic company documents.

The reference text is a visual transcription of the fixture and is intended only to catch broken OCR, page rendering, and table extraction paths.

SYNTHETIC OCR DEMO - NOT A REAL COMPANY POLICY
Commerce Operations Test Note
This synthetic page exists only to verify the PDF upload and OCR inspection workflow. The sample values and rules below are invented for testing and must never be treated as business evidence.
Inventory allocation: review sales velocity, stockout history, current units on hand, and supplier lead time before changing replenishment. This sample does not set a reorder threshold.
Promotion planning: compare delivered orders and recorded discounts across comparable periods. Without a holdout group, a before-and-after difference is descriptive and does not prove promotion uplift.
Nationwide logistics: compare actual transit time by region. Carrier, warehouse origin, route capacity, and promised delivery SLA are required before proposing network changes.
